description.value: Provisions Italiana is an Italian restaurant operated by Executive Table Group, located inside the boutique Seaside Hotel in North Vancouver's vibrant Shipyards District at Lower Lonsdale. The kitchen focuses on Roman-style pizzas, northern Italian pastas, and a celebrated vegetable program inspired by Italian countryside cooking, served in a warm room anchored by an open kitchen and flickering fireplace. It's a sit-down destination for cyclists finishing a ride along the North Shore waterfront.
